headline: A law that renames a Brookhaven, Mississippi post office after three local law enforcement officers.
what_it_does: This law names the Postal Service building at 201 West Cherokee Street in Brookhaven, Mississippi, the Deputy Donald William Durr, Corporal Zach Moak, and Patrolman James White Memorial Post Office Building. It is a symbolic honor and does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on December 21, 2020.
